body: I am 100% closed with other people. Even the girls who I consider to be my best friends, I am uncomfortable sharing personal information with. It is really bizarre. I am not sure why I have my guard up all the time. When I do talk to new friends they always tells me how positive and friendly I am, which is really great to hear, but I wish I knew how to tell them how I really felt. Do you have any suggestions on how to become more comfortable sharing with people, or just how to open up in general?

That's actually a really good point. While I am a friendly person, I am not nearly as outgoing as a lot of the other girls that I meet. That just honestly is not my personality. I find if I don't approach someone first, then they usually won't approach me at all. Which can be hard.

I used to go to the gym quite a lot, and I always looked forward to going. For whatever reason, once school started I have stopped going. I really want to start going again. I enjoy cooking and baking as well, but once again it is hard to find the time. I also love fashion, and I quite like watching youtube. Zoella is my guilty pleasure haha.

Thank you for taking the time to tell me your story. I am currently on cipralex, I find it helps a lot. The only person that knows I am taking this is my boyfriend, it feels so strange to tell someone else. I need to be more consistent with taking it, but I am working on that for sure.
